query:
SELECT 
  CASE WHEN phone IS NOT NULL AND phone != '' THEN 'has_phone' ELSE 'no_phone' END AS phone_status,
  COUNT(*) AS total
FROM leads 
WHERE DATEDIFF(NOW(), createdAt) >= 365
  AND preferredChannel = 'Email'
  AND (opportunityStatus IS NULL OR opportunityStatus NOT IN ('won', 'lost', 'abandoned'))
  AND humanTakeover = 0
GROUP BY CASE WHEN phone IS NOT NULL AND phone != '' THEN 'has_phone' ELSE 'no_phone' END;
